top_signals.title: World Faces Risk Cocktail From AI, Oil and Debt, Says IMF Chief
top_signals.summary: Global governments must act urgently to address challenges from an unbalanced AI boom, a prolonged energy shock and record debt piles, the International Monetary Fund said as it prepares to host economy chiefs from around the world next week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
